evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any specific concerns or stress source about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after the full intake, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer said 'No, no, not at this time.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Estimate-variability framing landed ('possible that it's going to be less than that... we will only be paying for the actual hours rendered'), but no rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Proactively offered a cheaper Sunday rate as an alternative when the customer said she needed to check with her partner — a nice, low-pressure way to keep the door open on price.
coaching_note: The agenda question landed late in the call rather than up front — moving it earlier would let the rep build the whole discovery conversation around whatever she says, rather than bolting it on right before the pitch.
